title: ExoMamba: Selective State-Space Models for TESS Exoplanet Vetting
description:
Research code for a controlled feasibility study of selective state-space models (Mamba) applied to confirmed-planet (CP) versus false-positive (FP) vetting of TESS Objects of Interest from complete global light curves of length L = 18,000.

The repository contains the full data pipeline (MAST download, preprocessing, TIC-level split generation), the Mamba model and its AstroNet-style CNN and catalog logistic-regression baselines, the versioned sealed split files, stored per-sample test predictions, and a single script that recomputes every bootstrap confidence interval and DeLong test reported in the accompanying paper without retraining.

Headline result: on 1,576 labelled TOIs under a sealed TIC-level split, a compact 131K-parameter Mamba model reaches AUC-ROC 0.806 (95% bootstrap CI [0.747, 0.857]) against 0.604 for a single-branch CNN and 0.605 for catalog logistic regression (DeLong p = 3.7e-8). The work is framed as controlled feasibility evidence, not a state-of-the-art vetting catalog.
